faq_heading: Mission houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Mission houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 212 of 327, or 65%. A further 61 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Mission?
faq.a: $910,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $780,000 and $1,095,000.

faq.q: Which Mission area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Lake Errock, at $865,000 across 11 sales at $359 a square foot, median year built 2007. The highest of the 4 lowest was Mission-West at $1,725,000.

faq.q: How fast do Mission houses sell?
faq.a: 35 days at the median, closing at 97.0% of the last list price, with 8% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Mission, 212 of the 327 houses (65%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $910,000, with the middle half between $780,000 and $1,095,000. The busiest price range, $800,000 to $999,999, had 119 sales.

blocks.text: What $1,000,000 buys in Mission by property type

Against Mission houses, where 65% of sales were under $1,000,000, condos had 100% under it (41 of 41 sales); houses with a legal suite had 37% under it (17 of 46 sales); coach and laneway houses had 17% under it (1 of 6 sales).

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Mission

In Lake Errock the median house sold for $865,000 across 11 sales, $135,000 under $1,000,000. Across Mission the median house took 35 days to sell and closed at 97.0% of the last list price, with 8% of the 327 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
